queries.fanout:
SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(l.amount) AS line_total, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.id;
queries.distinct:
SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(DISTINCT l.amount) AS line_total, SUM(DISTINCT p.amount) AS payment_total
FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.id;
